title: Founding Engineer
rubric: Shipped full-stack features end to end (React, TypeScript, Node.js)
Built for scale (high-volume events or telemetry)
Experience with AI agents or observability tooling
questions: Walk me through something you built end to end, front end to back end. What would you change now?
How would you design a pipeline that ingests millions of telemetry events without losing any?
Tell me about a time an AI agent or automated system failed on an edge case. How did you find and fix it?

title: Full-Stack Engineer
rubric: Owns features end to end, front end and back end
questions: Tell me about a product you built and owned end to end. What was the hardest part?
How would you design the API and storage behind a feature that generates audio for thousands of users?
How do you test and secure something you ship?

title: General interest (not an official posting)
questions: Walk me through the project you're proudest of. What did you build yourself?
What's the hardest bug you've shipped a fix for?
Walk me through a technical decision you'd make differently now.
